claims.statement: For CB(8,92) at p=492 and CB(8,93) at p=498, exact tree-polynomial replay gives eligible lower-region rows with every original leaf favorable and complete aggregate S<0.
claims.scope: Only the two choked-broom trees and ranks listed; bounded exact computation, with no universal inference.
claims.reason: retained: copy-based replay exactly reproduces the sealed evidence; both strict guards, the full original-leaf selector, multiplicity-weighted summands, and negative complete sums check for these two rows.

claims.statement: For every independent upper set containing h and v in either specified CB graph, the complete set of legal two-for-one targets consists of the arm support s and the choke c_i for exactly those branches with one occupied support; the exact aggregate arc counts are recorded.
claims.scope: Only upper independent sets containing h and v in the two specified CB graphs and ranks; it is an arc classification, not a full-flow result.
claims.reason: retained: the graph recipe exhausts absent vertex types; s qualifies, c_i qualifies exactly with one occupied support, and every other absent type has fewer than two occupied neighbors. The reported counts follow from the branch polynomials.

claims.statement: In each of the two specified CB rows, the h,v-containing upper sources having a branch with one occupied support and at least four leaves admit a capacity-respecting unit routing through the legal choke insertion that deletes h and that support; the exact routed supply and uncovered upper demand are recorded.
claims.scope: The stated source subfamily in CB(8,92), p=492 and CB(8,93), p=498; no claim of saturation for the full weighted graph.
claims.reason: retained: the selected choke insertion is legal; output fibers have at most 8-ell incoming sources and at least ell units of tag capacity for ell>=4. The coefficient and replay give exact routed and unrouted amounts. This does not imply full saturation.

limitations: Replay is bounded to CB(8,92), p=492 and CB(8,93), p=498.
The choke routing covers only the specified h,v-containing subfamily, not all weighted upper supply.
The cut envelopes are inconclusive and the bounded examples do not resolve the universal lower-region aggregate.
